verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, a hardware product that has no API surface of its own, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence does not show any such capability that would make the axis apply: the oneAPI and OpenVINO mentions are general toolkit and framework support, not an interactive API reference, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.
